claim: Effective models cover the entire human brain.
originalWording: Effective models cover the entire human brain.

sources.title: So what is the singularity? — Ray Kurzweil Q&A

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Effective functional models cover all major human brain regions and their integrated operation, not just a wiring atlas.
reference.rationale: Using 2025 as the explicit midpoint of “mid-2020s,” major regional/animal mapping existed but not this complete human functional model. The human cortical parcellation, mouse atlas and fly connectome are genuine partial achievements. They do not establish complete human emulation.
